text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai. Having heard about Sakura Chiyono O's situation, Yaeno Muteki declares to Mejiro Ardan that her victory is assured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inferring from Yaeno Muteki's words that she means to make this the ultimate race for Sakura Chiyono O's sake, Mejiro Ardan makes a clear show of both her delight and her competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pledging to show their friend that they can all surpass their limits together, Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki get ready to race.
